events.title: Spain immigration scheme sees 1.2 million apply for legal status
events.description: Spain's immigration scheme has seen over 1 million applications, with Latin Americans leading the numbers at 67 percent.

events.title: Gibilterra strengthens border controls ahead of barrier removal
events.description: Gibilterra is strengthening its border controls ahead of the removal of the barrier with Spain.

events.title: Venezuela quake survivor pulled out alive after eight days
events.description: A survivor of the Venezuela earthquake has been pulled out alive after eight days under the rubble.

events.title: Turkey and Greece in talks to ease tensions in the Eastern Mediterranean
events.description: Turkey and Greece are in talks to ease tensions in the Eastern Mediterranean, with the goal of reducing conflict and improving relations.

events.title: Vatican excommunicates hundreds of thousands of splinter sect followers
events.description: The Vatican has excommunicated around 600,000 followers of the Society of Saint Pius X, a Catholic sect.
